title: Deceptive pricing
content:
After being recommended by my accountant I have been using MileIQ for 2.5mo. After the initial 7 day trial I was automatically enrolled in a plan that cost $139.99/yr. This seemed pretty darn expensive for someone with a couple business drives/wk, I ran the numbers and decided I would still likely save more than it cost so went for it. Later I discovered that they had lower priced options that would have worked well for me that were not made available to me when it auto subscribed. 

As for the app itself it’s fine. I’m not a big fan of any app constantly recording me so I turn it on when leaving for a business drive. I have found it frequently impossible to link drives together, for example from office to airport with a stop for lunch. Sometimes it gives the option and you just say yes, other times it does not and it is not possible to link. Addresses are often wrong. Most of my drives seem to begin at my neighbors place. The biggest reason I will not renew is that with my quickbooks subscription I have access to essentially the same service for no added expense. I would maybe have felt more charitable about the whole thing if they had initially subscribed at $2.99/mo for a basic service rather than $139.99/yr for way more drives than i need.
